reviews.body:
I checked the negative-duration change at 41b6f21 against ClickHouse 26.10.13.11. Parse followed by String matched the server for both Time and Time64(9) on five inputs: the negative and positive 999-hour endpoints, -01:02:03.456, and one nanosecond on either side of zero. For the subsecond cases I supplied only the integral part to Time. In particular, the server and the client both rendered -1 ns as `-00:00:00.000000001`, while the seconds-only value rendered as `00:00:00`.

The new TestTime_Negative also passed locally.
